items.title: Blackstone (BX) Buys HSBC’s Australian Loan Book And DarkVision Technologies
items.summary: HSBC has agreed to sell its Australian loan book to Blackstone, expanding Blackstone's presence in Australian credit markets. Blackstone has also acquired DarkVision Technologies, a company focused on advanced infrastructure inspection technology. Blackstone, traded as NYSE:BX, is adding two very different assets to its portfolio at the same time. items.title: Jersey Mike’s Stock Slides Below IPO Price in Market Debut
items.summary: Jersey Mike’s Subs  is a sandwich chain that professes to make “A Sub Above.”  The New Jersey-based company’s stock made its debut Thursday on the New York Stock Exchange with the ticker symbol JMKE.  At Thursday’s closing price, Jersey Mike’s has a market value of $6.9 billion.

items.title: Jersey Mike’s Stock Falls 6% in Trading Debut
items.summary: Jersey Mike's shares fell at the New York Stock Exchange Thursday after it priced about 43.5 million shares at $23 each late yesterday.  The company debuted with a valuation of nearly $8 billion, just 18-months after private-equity firm Blackstone took a majority-stake.  Blackstone will retain control over the sandwich-maker, as just 13.7% of voting power will be transferred to shareholders post-IPO.
